description: Rename a board, rewrite the line under its title, change when it deletes itself, or lay its panels out. A board is a grid: every row spans the full width, its panels share it equally (one to four) at one height. Pass `rows` to set the layout outright, top to bottom, as rows of panel ids from get_board; panels you leave out keep their order after them. Or pass `arrange` to straighten the rows as they read now. Pass only what changes. Panels are changed with update_panel and delete_panel.

arrange.description: Straighten the rows in their current order: numbers together, charts in pairs, one height per row.

description.description: One sentence saying what the board is for, at most 100 characters. Empty clears it.

expiresInDays.description: Delete the board this many days from today; 0 keeps it for good.

rows.description: The rows, top to bottom, e.g. [["12","13","14","15"],["16","17"],["18"]]: numbers up to four to a row, charts two, a table or text on its own.

name: update_board
title: Update board
